name: Diethylstilbestrol Diphosphate
summary: Diethylstilbestrol Diphosphate has liver and heart ratings calculated by a small computer model rather than through tests on people [M]. This computer program rated the drug's liver score at 44 in the low category and its heart score at 28 in the low category [M]. The available records list no specific problems, similar issues, or Food and Drug Administration notices for this drug [1][2].
